purpose: Natural evidence use and complete-task cost; no forced tool selection

comparisons.model: Same explicit model and effort in both arms; pin before paid execution
comparisons.instructions: Same user task and task constraints; each arm's actual shipped routing/skill is part of treatment; never instruct task to call a named ops tool
comparisons.failedAttempts: Retain all errors, retries and timeouts; no replacement runs

hardGates: Every production Python function CRAP <= 6; unchanged Rust outside Python score explicitly noted
No failed task regraded by changing oracle after seeing outcomes
Candidate strict success count no lower than baseline; investigate every baseline-success/candidate-failure pair before release
No index or reference grants source permission; no read-only MCP command execution
metrics: outer exec and native actions separately
raw exact retrieval and source correctness
releaseRule: Report each target PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN under frozen definitions. A missed target cannot silently become a pass. Keep failed cost target candidates experimental until redesigned or the user explicitly changes release objectives.
adoptionRule: Do not divide workflow calls by every tool call. Label task opportunities and audit labels; exclude plugin development and descendant agents from daily-work cohort.
